confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Kuala Lumpur price levels, extrapolated to July 2026; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Meal and coffee anchors are the most reliable; hotel and bar anchors vary more by season and venue. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor. USD values assume roughly 4.2 ringgit per US dollar. The RBA figure came from search results on the RBA domain and was not confirmed on a second RBA page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other Southeast Asian capital and tourist cities, adjusted for Malaysia's high alcohol taxes (beer and wine priced well above regional neighbours) and central KL hotel levels.

anchor_basis.beer: Carlsberg or Tiger draft (about 500 ml) at a casual restaurant with service charge, about 18 MYR.
anchor_basis.coffee: Cappuccino at an independent cafe in Bangsar or Bukit Bintang, about 13 MYR.
anchor_basis.inexp_meal_1p: Char kway teow or nasi goreng plate at a kopitiam or food court, about 14 MYR.
anchor_basis.midrange_meal_2p: Three-course meal for two at a mid-range Western restaurant incl. service and tax, about 240 MYR.
anchor_basis.cocktail: Standard gin and tonic or mojito at a mid-range bar in Bukit Bintang or Bangsar, about 42 MYR.
anchor_basis.wine_glass: House wine by the glass at a mid-range restaurant, about 36 MYR.
anchor_basis.hostel_dorm_1p: Dorm bed in a registered hostel in Bukit Bintang or Chinatown, about 50 MYR per night.
anchor_basis.hostel_private_2p: Private double room in a registered budget hostel, about 130 MYR per night.
anchor_basis.hotel_1star_2p: Basic registered guesthouse or budget hotel double room near KL Sentral or Chinatown, about 150 MYR per night.
anchor_basis.hotel_3star_2p: Standard double room at a registered three-star hotel in central KL, about 300 MYR per night.
